description: The v13 AHCIP prompt is an additive draft of v12 with one appended section, `## V13 EXAMPLES AND TIGHTENINGS`, that adds (D1) a negative example for dx_linkage, (D2) a positive few-shot for missing_procedure, (D3) a negative example for preventive_opportunity, and (D4) one boundary-tightening for the telehealth premium rule. The v12 text is unchanged; the additions are purely additive. NOT yet measured against the live LLM. See docs/AHCIP_V13_DESIGN.md for the analysis and measurement plan. Re-run `python scripts/smartness_test_v12.py --live-llm --prompt prompts/v13/auditor_prompt.txt --out v13_first.json` to obtain a real v13 number; compare against `v12_current.json` produced by the same script run with the default v12 prompt.

loaders.default: ai_billing_audit.auditor.load_prompt() with no path argument resolves to the Dockerfile-installed copy under src/ at import time via importlib.resources. To exercise the v13 draft without overwriting the deployed v12 prompt, pass --prompt prompts/v13/auditor_prompt.txt to scripts/smartness_test_v12.py.

open_questions: Is the live-llm F1 on the current 19/31 val set higher than v12's documented 0.690 (10/13)? Get a fresh v12 baseline first.
Does D1 reduce dx_linkage false positives on the current split? (The 5 historical false positives are no longer in the gold.)
Does D2 increase missing_procedure recall? Three of the 31 gold findings depend on this rule.
Does D3 reduce preventive_opportunity over-firing on encounters where the note documents up-to-date status?
